# Ugnius Motiejunas

> Ugnius Motiejunas (Ugnius Motiejūnas) is a full-stack AI engineer from Vilnius, Lithuania. He builds Trimata (trimata.lt), interactive 3D product configurators and 3D visualisations for manufacturers and online shops.

He built Bonder (bonder.lt), an events discovery platform for Vilnius with a native iOS app on the App Store, which reached 12.7k unique visitors and 200+ registered accounts within its first three months.
Earlier he worked as a software engineer at Danske Bank (C#/.NET microservices, Kafka, Kubernetes) and Nordics Software (Go, React), and interned at Swedbank and Ruptela. In 2026 he spent two months at Network School and three months as a Builder at Lost Astronaut, a venture builder. He holds a BSc in Software Engineering from Vilnius University.

## Projects
- [Bonder: Events Platform & iOS App](https://udevelops.com/project/bonder/): Bonder (bonder.lt) is an events discovery platform for Vilnius: a web app plus a native iOS app on the App Store. I designed, built and grew it solo, from the backend and event import pipeline to SEO and the App Store release. 12.7k unique visitors, 205 registered accounts and 1,068 events listed in its first three months.
- [Trimata: Interactive 3D Product Configurators](https://udevelops.com/project/trimata/): Trimata (trimata.lt) is my 3D product studio, started in November 2026. I build browser-based 3D configurators for makers of saunas, kitchens, doors, roofing and decks: buyers choose size, colours and add-ons, see the price, and send a precise specification.
- [Embeddable AI Chatbot Widget](https://udevelops.com/project/chatbot-widget/): A multi-tenant AI chatbot platform businesses embed on their site to handle support conversations and hand off to a human the moment the bot shouldn't be guessing. Built for Starkodas.
- [Real-Time Radio Network & Emergency Services Management Console](https://udevelops.com/project/radio-network-console/): A comprehensive fleet and network management console built for PMR/TETRA radio network operators and emergency services. Combines asset administration with real-time monitoring of GPS positions, signal strength, and device status across an entire radio network, all rendered on interactive maps.
- [Coca-Cola Lottery Web App](https://udevelops.com/project/cocacola-lottery/): A lottery web application built for official Coca-Cola Lithuania client. Developed with React, TypeScript, and Vite, featuring a fast, responsive interface and secure functionality for managing lottery entries.
- [AI Sales chatbot](https://udevelops.com/project/whatsapp-chatbot/): An intelligent WhatsApp sales assistant built for CIMES, an Argentinian logistics franchise. Cimi attends customers, offers products, and closes sales automatically, 24/7. Powered by GPT-4o and orchestrated with n8n for instant, human-like responses.
- [Business Website](https://udevelops.com/project/business-website/): A modern business website built with Hugo for a client. Features dark mode, multilingual support, and lightning-fast performance. Currently used as a demo but ready for real-world deployment.
